To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MAbs directed to Ley can be obtained by immunizing mice with synthetic antigen.
the synthetic carbohydrate antigen, Ley-PAA, is a potent antigen for the generation of MAbs, and the obtained MAbs are highly specific and useful for the identification of Ley (+) cells.

a synthetic antigen Ley-PAA- PE adsorbed on S. minnesota is a potent immunogen; MAbs obtained against the synthetic antigen are specific and recognize Ley antigen; MAbs obtained are useful for immunological and immunohistological studies of cancer- and HIV- associated antigen Lewisy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and characterization of a novel immunogen, Ley-PAA.
the preparation of synthetic carbohydrate antigen and its use in the generation of MAbs directed to Ley.
the synthesis of a spacer-armed Ley antigen coupled with lipophilic polymer and the preparation of MAbs directed to this antigen.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MAbs generated against synthetic antigen were specific for Ley and that the synthetic antigen Ley-PAA- PE was suitable for the immunization of mice.
MAbs generated against the synthetic antigen Ley-PAA- PE are specific for the Ley epitope, and that the synthetic antigen can be used for the production of MAbs directed to the Ley epitope.
MAbs generated against synthetic antigen Ley-PAA-PAE are directed to Ley.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a synthetic antigen Ley-PAA-PA can serve as a basis for the preparation of MAbs against Ley.
the synthetic antigen, Ley-PAA, was successfully used for the generation of specific MAbs directed against Ley.

a synthetic Ley antigen is an effective immunogen for the generation of specific MAbs and that the use of spacer-armed tetra- and oligosaccharides in the preparation of MAbs against carbohydrate determinants is an effective approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthetic carbohydrate antigen can be used for the production of antibodies against carbohydrate antigens.
the synthetic antigen Ley-PAA- PE adsorbed on bacteria can be used as a potent immunogen to generate MAbs directed to Ley.
MAbs to synthetic antigen are able to distinguish the antigen from its isomers, and that the synthetic antigen is a suitable tool for generating MAbs to Ley.
